query_normalized: quantifying the impact of network proximity on epidemic spreading in scale-free networks physics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) because it investigates the dynamical behavior of an irreversible spreading process (opinion spreading) on the exact same network topology (Barabási-Albert scale-free networks) and explicitly analyzes the role of network proximity via "degree of occupied sites" and "hubs," which serves as a canonical proxy for the mechanism of epidemic spreading in this domain.
